name: How does GEO implementation improve local search rankings?

mainEntity.name: How does GEO implementation improve local search rankings?

acceptedAnswer.text: GEO implementation enhances local search rankings by optimizing a business's online presence for location-specific queries. This includes creating location-specific landing pages, ensuring consistent Name, Address, and Phone (NAP) information across online directories, and generating local citations. Search engines recognize these signals as indicators of local relevance, boosting visibility in local search results and making it easier for nearby customers to find services like AI Visibility Solutions.
